generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Conditional tenders will NOT be accepted and the tender is of two cover system.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Aspiring Bidders/Contractors who have not obtained the user ID & Password for participating in e-Procurement, may now obtain the same from the website www.eproc.karnataka.gov.in

Corrigendum/ modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the website only. For any clarification on e- Procurement, contact the office of the Executive Engineer (O&M)Bhadra, Bhadra Generating Station, KPCL, B.R.Project,577115, Bhadravathi - Tq, Shimoga - Dist, Karnataka, Mob No.:9449598814,
Section I, II, III, Instruction to bidders, Form of Bid, and Self declaration are part of the Tender document.
After evaluation of Technical Bid and whose offer meet the PQR and technical specification of the tender/bid in complete manner will be accepted and only such bidders Financial bid will be opened.

Prices for each item specified in work estimate shall be uploaded in the e-portal itself. Prices will be evaluated based on the rates quoted in the e-portal i.e., the sum total price of items forming the total bid amount.

Note: Rates per unit quoted shall be FOR destination basis and inclusive of packing forwarding, loading, unloading, transportation, freight and insurance charges and any other allowances and exclusive of GST.
Right to accept or reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason is reserved by the undersigned.
The bidder shall quote in Indian Rupees only. The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of all the applicable taxes & exclusive of GST as per the latest GOK/GOI orders.
The quantity of materials and work mentioned/indicated in tender may vary depending on the final requirement at the time of placing the work order.

Bidders are advised to visit the work site at Bhadra Generating Station before bidding to obtain the hands-on information if required about the quantum of work and supply involved from the concerned division head. Further, post tender correspondences regarding technical specification, scope of work and supply involved will not be entertained and it is the responsibility of the bidders to get any queries cleared before bidding for subject work.

KPCL reserves the right to verify the authenticity of any or all the certificates furnished by any or all the tenders from the authorities who have issued the same. If it is found that any of the agency/agencies have furnished false certificates/ information, the tenders submitted by them are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular manufacturer/contractor/agency/firm and have proven experience for being successfully carried out the work of Supply and Installation of 11kV or above VCB/ SF6 Breaker to power utilities / reputed organizations. In proof of the above, the bidder shall upload scanned copies of work order and corresponding work completion/work done certificate for at least one single order for preceding 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) towards execution of similar work with contract value not less than Rs. 10.32 Lakh issued from competent authority.

itemList.description: Supply, erection, testing and commissioning of 11KV outdoor kiosk with complete cubicle which includes 1 No. of 11kV, 630A, 25kA outdoor type vacuum circuit breaker for Incomer feeder & 2 No. of 11kV, 630A, 25kA outdoor type vacuum circuit breaker for outgoing feeders along with Protection and Metering System, CTs, VTs, protective relays, annunciation panel & complete system as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Grounding of equipment with 50 x 6 mm G.I. Flat and connecting equipment to the earthmat/ground pit. Each point of earthing with all formation works like bending, twisting, drilling of holes and connecting by welding (inclusive of all T&P and consumables) to the earthmat/ground pit/point of earth connection, all the materials supplied by the contractor as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Supply of indoor type end termination kits (1 Set=3 nos.) as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Supply of outdoor type end termination kits (1 Set=3 nos.) as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Supplying & Laying of GI cable trays including welding, fixing of supports Cable tray of 300 mm width (suitable for 2 runs of 3 core 120Sq mm 11KV cable ) as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Supply of 19 core, 2.5 Sqmm copper control cable for protection, remote indication, annunciation and operation from 11KV kiosk to control room of BGS 19C x 2.5 Sq mm as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Releasing of HT cable after excavation refilling, consolidation Rewinding to the drum etc., 11KV 120 Sqmm, 3 Core XLPE cable as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Laying of 11 kV cables in existing trench/G.I. pipe/stoneware pipe/RCC hume pipe using wooden/aluminium rollers as directed by departmental staff 3x95 to 150 Sqmm as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Laying of cable in Existing Trench/GI pipe/Stone Ware/RCC Hume pipe using Wooden/Aluminum Rollers as directed by the departmental staff 2.5 to 25 Sqmm as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.

Supply of essential spares 
Breaker Closing coil -2 Nos.
Breaker Tripping Coil - 2 Nos.
Breaker Fixed and moving contacts- 1 No.
 Breaker Spring Charging Motor- 1 No.
 HT Fuses- 6 Nos.
Electromechanical & Numerical trip relays (each 1 No) 
as specified in Section-III, Technical Specifications and Scope of work. NOTE: The rates quoted shall exclusive of GST and inclusive of all other taxes and duties.
